page_title: GRA 1-1 BET | Granada CF v Betis 28/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Borja Iglesias (Betis) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Victor Garcia who sees an offensive foul.
90+6' A precise low pass is received by Borja Iglesias (Betis), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
90+5' A pass into the box finds Shon Weissman (Granada CF) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Claudio Bravo denies him.
90+4' Rodri (Betis) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+3' Rodri (Betis) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+2' Betis have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
90+1' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) causes Claudio Bravo little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
90+1' A player from Granada CF commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' A shot from the edge of the box by Borja Iglesias (Betis) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
83' That was close! Lucas Boye (Granada CF) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.

83' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Claudio Bravo, who pulls off a decent save!
81' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Assane Diao will be replaced by Juan Cruz (Betis).
81' Substitution. Marc Roca (Betis) has come on for Isco.
80' Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
79' Granada CF will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
78' Shon Weissman (Granada CF) meets a cross inside the box, but Claudio Bravo wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
74' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) is replacing Antonio Puertas.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gerard Gumbau leaves the pitch and Shon Weissman (Granada CF) comes on.
73' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Ayoze Perez is replaced by Borja Iglesias (Betis).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andres Guardado trots off the pitch and is replaced by William Carvalho (Betis).

69' Rodri (Betis) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Andre Ferreira anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.

67' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Lucas Boye (Granada CF) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Bryan Zaragoza. The score is now 1:1.
66' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
65' Ayoze Perez (Betis) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
65' Isco (Betis) will deliver the corner kick.
63' Paco Lopez has decided to make a change. Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) replaces Gonzalo Villar.
62' It's time for a substitution. Jose Callejon (Granada CF) comes on in place of Oscar Melendo.
62' The Betis players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Victor Garcia signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
60' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Victor Garcia is going to take a look using VAR.
59' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Chadi Riad (Betis) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
59' Betis fail to score from a corner as Andre Ferreira (Granada CF) leaps to collect the ball.

59' A sweet pass finds Isco (Betis) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top left corner. Andre Ferreira is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.
58' The substitution is prepared. Rodri (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Abde Ezzalzouli.
56' Betis enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

51' 0 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Assane Diao (Betis) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
50' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
50' The referee blows his whistle, Granada CF are awarded a corner kick.
50' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Granada CF will take a corner.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Granada CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Abner (Betis) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Granada CF have a free kick.
47' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' A pass by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Victor Garcia has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) tries to find Isco, but he puts too much power on the pass.
45+1' Victor Garcia couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lucas Boye (Granada CF) and blew his whistle.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' German Pezzella (Betis) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
45' Isco (Betis) is about to take a corner kick.
45' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Betis will take a corner kick.
44' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
43' The game is interrupted. Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
41' Raul Torrent (Granada CF) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
39' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
38' Myrto Uzuni is being substituted because of an injury. Paco Lopez sends Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) on the pitch.
37' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' The foul by Ayoze Perez (Betis) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) cracks a volley from just outside the box and his bad shot goes way wide of the right post. It will be a goal kick.
34' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
31' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
30' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

29' Abner (Betis) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
28' Half-chance! Lucas Boye (Granada CF) plays a pass into the box, but Claudio Bravo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
28' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
27' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Betis.
26' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
25' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
23' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
23' The ball is cleared after Lucas Boye (Granada CF) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Granada CF win a corner kick.
22' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Claudio Bravo is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
21' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

21' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Claudio Bravo makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball is out of play. Granada CF will have a chance to score from a corner.

20' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Claudio Bravo pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
19' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
19' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post.

17' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Claudio Bravo pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
17' Granada CF have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
17' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
16' Victor Garcia blows for a foul after Aitor Ruibal (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
14' Assane Diao (Betis) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
14' Assane Diao (Betis) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
11' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post.
10' Isco (Betis) takes the corner with a short pass.
10' Ayoze Perez (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
9' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
8' Isco (Betis) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Andre Ferreira comes off his line to intercept.
7' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
6' A lofted pass into the box is met by Assane Diao (Betis), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
5' Isco (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
4' Isco (Betis) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
3' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
2' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

2' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Granada CF force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The first half has just begun.
Betis will kick the game off.
Victor Garcia is introduced as the referee for today's match.
